While 
Sailing 
While the tug boat towing barge was en route from Singapore 
to Vung Tau, Vietnam, the Master of the tug boat was alerted 
by Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS) to a 
suspected incident involving a perpetrator onboard LKH 2882. 
Upon further inspection, the Mast
er observed a sampan 
alongside the barge and approximately six perpetrators 
onboard the barge. Some scrap metals were stolen from the 
barge. All crew members onboard the tug boat were 
accounted for, with no injuries reported . The Master 
subsequently informed VTIS that the tug boat and barge 
would continue their voyage and no assistance was required. 
Safety broadcast on anti- piracy watch carried out to warn 
vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the 
Singapore Strait (SS).
